blocks.text: 1916. COHEN JOINS THE CANADIAN ARMY. AT THE FRONT, HE SPEAKS BROKEN CANTONESE, SO HE IS PUT IN CHARGE OF THE CHINESE LABOURERS LAYING THE RAILWAY TRACKS.
FASTER, LADS!|THE SHELLS DON'T|TAKE A BREAK!
AFTER THE WAR, NO MORE WORK IN CANADA. IN 1922, HE SAILS FOR CHINA TO SELL A RAILWAY CONTRACT.
THE RAILWAY WILL NEVER BE BUILT. COHEN WILL STAY TWENTY YEARS.
